title: WHAT IF YOU GOT A 5-STAR WANTED LEVEL IN REAL LIFE?

segments.line: That's when
Ellie comes downstairs, holding a chocolate bar from the corner store.
She forgot to pay. She's seven.
And above her head, very faint at first, one star begins to fill in.
Ellie can't see it. But she can see your face. 'Am I in trouble? '
You understand two things at once. The stars aren't only yours any more.
They spread to the people standing closest to you.
And outside, there are four police cars and a helicopter.
Mum looks out of the window at the flashing lights, then at you. 'What did you do? '
And for the first time, you tell her the truth. All of it.
Your phone buzzes. It's Mo. 'Run. Out the back, through the gardens. Hide long enough and they fade. You know that. '
But you know something else now.
Running is what made it worse. Every single time.
Reyes is watching you. 'It's your choice, ' she says. 'Not mine. '
So you take Ellie's hand, and her chocolate bar, and you walk her back to the corner store,
and you pay for it. Her star flickers, and goes out.
The whole street is lit up blue and red. Neighbours at every window.
An officer with a megaphone, calm and slow. 'Nobody is in trouble yet. Let's keep it that way. '
Then you walk back out into the street, slowly, hands where everyone can see them, towards the lights. And one by one,
your stars go out.
